obfuscation_indicators: projected capital outlays can be adjusted
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally quantitative and explains revenue, earnings, segment performance, liquidity, debt, and planned capital expenditures with reasonable specificity. Risk exposure remains tied to pandemic-sensitive travel and live events, operating-cost inflation, discretionary demand, acquisitions, and substantial debt obligations, although the tone emphasizes recovery and covenant compliance. Some forward-looking and generic funding language limits visibility into downside scenarios.
